newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JANSEN SEES CELTIC LOSE FIRST LEAGUE GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JANSEN SEES CELTIC LOSE FIRST LEAGUE GAME.

text.p: Celtic's new trainer Wim Jansen saw his side stumble to a 2-1 defeat by Hibernian in their opening Scottish premier division match of the season on Sunday.

Chic Charnley earned Hibs their first win over the Glasgow side in 21 attempts when he picked up a loose pass from debutant Henrik Larsson, a second-half substitute, to drill home a fierce shot from just outside the penalty box in the 75th minute.
Celtic, hoping under former Feyenoord coach Jansen to deny Rangers a 10th successive league title, fell behind in the 24th minute, Lee Power sidefooting home from Tony Rougier's pinpoint cross.
Malky Mackay headed an equaliser five minutes later but from then on Celtic were frequently second best to a spirited Hibs side.
Rangers begin the defence of their title at home to Hearts on Monday.
